reviews.title: Committed to this change
reviews.text: First, I am not one to pay for an app. But, when I saw I could pay $20 for a one yr membership, I added the app to help track my progress and to keep me on track. I am a middle aged woman. I rarely step on a scale. But, in June 26’, I did. I was ashamed at my weight of 199 lbs. and equally ashamed of not taking better care of myself. That’s what filled me with the determination to make a real change. I began walking every day. I began with 1 mile and with using this app. Now, I walk most days 3-5 miles. I stay in my calorie deficit most days. In 14 weeks, I have lost 22 lbs. my goal is 50. This app is really good. It tracks my calories. I can scan my food and it knows how many calories it is. Or, I can use my voice to tell what I’ve eaten and it knows the calories. It also provides suggested daily meals that you can print. I must also say, I usually eat only once per day. That has worked for me. As this app also tracks fasting hours. It also keeps track of my water intake. And shows my progress in all areas available. I am pleased with this app and in all that it tracks for my weight loss goals. If you are ready to commit to a change for the better for your health and fitness, this app helps if you truly stay on track. All my best to you. You can do it!

reviews.text:
I’ve used other calorie counters and never stuck with them.  Calo: Ai has been my game changer!  I’m on day 48 and still super motivated.  I want to log everything I eat so I can stay on track.  I bought the year subscription and it was the best $20 on an app I’ve spent.  It’s extremely accurate and so easy to use.  It counts calories, carbs, protein, and fat.  I can literally describe what I ate (like, speak it) and it listens and calculates the calories.  You can also take a picture of your food and it calculates the macros! I can also add my own calories if they are inaccurate or if I don’t want to put in every single macro.  I can scan barcodes to get nutritional information and it directly inputs into my food log.  It links to my Apple Watch so when I work out, it adds the burned calories automatically.  
It also has a variety of Macro (diet) options like Low Carb, GLP-1 optimization, Low Fat… to customize for anyone’s lifestyle.  And if that’s not enough, it offers recipes according to your Macro choice.  And they are good recipes!  They offer a free trial and there’s no ads.  Seriously! Try this app.  It is really very good!
